groups.title: 104th Top 10 Graduates
groups.def: The ten cadets ranked highest at the 104th Training Corps (Southern Division) graduation ceremony, as shown on screen.

groups.title: 104th Training Corps
groups.def: Cadets who graduated in Eren, Mikasa, and Armin's class of the 104th Training Corps, as named on screen in the anime.

groups.title: Levi Squad
groups.def: Levi's hand-picked Special Operations Squad within the Survey Corps, as shown before and during the Female Titan arc.

groups.title: Ackerman Family
groups.def: Named members of the Ackerman bloodline shown or explicitly mentioned on screen.

groups.title: Titan Shifters
groups.def: Characters confirmed in the anime to have inherited one of the Eight Titans other than the Founding Titan.

groups.title: Founding Titan Holders
groups.def: Characters confirmed in the anime to have inherited the Founding Titan itself.

groups.title: Royal Blood
groups.def: Characters explicitly identified in the anime as carrying royal (Fritz/Reiss) blood as descendants of Ymir Fritz.

groups.title: Marleyan Warriors
groups.def: Members of Marley's Warrior program (titan shifters and candidates) shown in the anime.

groups.title: Survey Corps Commanders
groups.def: Characters who served as Commander of the Survey Corps at some point in the anime.

groups.title: Garrison Regiment
groups.def: Named Garrison soldiers shown in the anime.

groups.title: Surnames That Are Also Words
groups.def: Characters whose surname is also a common English word.

groups.title: Secret Titan Shifters of the 104th
groups.def: 104th Training Corps graduates who were secretly Titan Shifters.

groups.title: Warriors Sent to Paradis (845)
groups.def: The four Warriors Marley sent to infiltrate Paradis Island in the year 845, starting the Paradis Island Operation.

groups.title: Top Military Brass
groups.def: Characters who held the rank of Commander (or Commander-in-Chief) of a military branch, as shown in the anime.
